nodes.description: ENS registry contract reference (ENS ens) stored at construction; used for the external owner() lookup in the only_owner modifier.
mapping(bytes32 => Record) records; primary storage of per-node addr, content, name, pubkey, text, abis and multihash.
Modifier only_owner(bytes32 node) that requires ens.owner(node) == msg.sender before executing the guarded function body.
constructor(ENS ensAddr) sets ens = ensAddr. No access control.
setAddr(bytes32 node, address addr) public only_owner(node); writes records[node].addr and emits AddrChanged.
setContent(bytes32 node, bytes32 hash) public only_owner(node); writes records[node].content and emits ContentChanged.
setMultihash(bytes32 node, bytes hash) public only_owner(node); writes records[node].multihash and emits MultihashChanged.
setName(bytes32 node, string name) public only_owner(node); writes records[node].name and emits NameChanged.
setABI(bytes32 node, uint256 contentType, bytes data) public only_owner(node); validates powers of two and writes records[node].abis[contentType].
setPubkey(bytes32 node, bytes32 x, bytes32 y) public only_owner(node); writes records[node].pubkey and emits PubkeyChanged.
setText(bytes32 node, string key, string value) public only_owner(node); writes records[node].text[key] and emits TextChanged.
text(bytes32 node, string key) public view; reads records[node].text[key].
pubkey(bytes32 node) public view; returns records[node].pubkey.x and .y.
ABI(bytes32 node, uint256 contentTypes) public view; loops over content types, shifting contentType each iteration to find stored ABI data.
name(bytes32 node) public view; returns records[node].name.
content(bytes32 node) public view; returns records[node].content.
multihash(bytes32 node) public view; returns records[node].multihash.
addr(bytes32 node) public view; returns records[node].addr.
supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceID) public pure; returns true for the set of supported interface constants.
msg.sender as used in the only_owner require comparison; attacker-controlled caller identity.
External call ens.owner(node) inside the only_owner modifier's require; executed on an externally supplied ENS address that may be untrusted/malicious.
Unchecked arithmetic (contentType - 1) & contentType in setABI; underflows when contentType == 0 and the power-of-two check can be bypassed.
Unchecked loop increment contentType <<= 1 in ABI(); shifting can overflow/truncate, permitting a non-terminating or mis-iterated loop for large contentTypes.
bytes32 node parameter of setAddr; used as the records mapping key.
address addr parameter of setAddr; stored into records[node].addr.
bytes32 node parameter of the only_owner modifier; query key for ens.owner(node).
bytes32 node parameter of setABI; used as the records mapping key.
uint256 contentType parameter of setABI; operand of the unchecked (contentType - 1) arithmetic.
bytes data parameter of setABI; stored into records[node].abis[contentType].
bytes32 node parameter of ABI(); used to fetch the Record storage pointer.
uint256 contentTypes bitmask parameter of ABI(); bounds the content-type scan loop.
Record storage record = records[node]; local storage pointer used throughout ABI().
Local/return contentType loop counter in ABI(); initialized to 1 and shifted left each iteration.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against ens.owner(node) in the only_owner require, making caller identity the sole access-control gate.
The only_owner modifier always performs the external ens.owner(node) call before any guarded function body executes.
The external call to the externally-set ENS contract can execute untrusted code and re-enter the resolver (or return a manipulated owner value) before state changes complete.
The stored ens state variable supplies the target address for the external owner() call.
The modifier's node parameter is the argument passed to ens.owner(node).
only_owner(node) gates execution of setAddr.
only_owner(node) gates execution of setContent.
only_owner(node) gates execution of setMultihash.
only_owner(node) gates execution of setName.
only_owner(node) gates execution of setABI.
only_owner(node) gates execution of setPubkey.
only_owner(node) gates execution of setText.
node parameter flows into setAddr and is forwarded to the only_owner check.
addr parameter flows into setAddr and is written to storage.
setAddr writes records[node].addr into the records mapping.
node is used as the records mapping key for the write.
setContent writes records[node].content.
setMultihash writes records[node].multihash.
setName writes records[node].name.
setPubkey writes records[node].pubkey.
setText writes records[node].text[key].
node parameter flows into setABI and indexes the records mapping.
data parameter flows into setABI and is stored in the abis sub-mapping.
setABI writes records[node].abis[contentType].data.
contentType parameter is the operand of the unchecked subtraction (contentType - 1), which underflows for contentType == 0.
setABI executes the unchecked power-of-two require expression without SafeMath, so an attacker-chosen contentType triggers the underflow path.
node parameter indexes records to obtain the Record storage pointer in ABI().
contentTypes bitmask bounds and filters the loop inside ABI().
The record storage pointer is dereferenced to read record.abis[contentType] in ABI().
ABI() performs the unchecked loop increment contentType <<= 1 with no overflow guard.
The local contentType counter is left-shifted each iteration; the unchecked shift can wrap and mis-iterate the loop.
The constructor assigns the externally supplied ENS address into the ens state variable.
text() reads records[node].text[key] from the records mapping.
pubkey() reads records[node].pubkey from the records mapping.
name() reads records[node].name from the records mapping.
content() reads records[node].content from the records mapping.
multihash() reads records[node].multihash from the records mapping.
addr() reads records[node].addr from the records mapping.
ABI() reads records[node].abis[contentType] from the records mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The node parameter is only meaningful as input to setAddr's storage write; fold it into the setAddr function node.
The addr parameter is only meaningful as the value written by setAddr; fold it into the setAddr function node.
The modifier's node parameter is only used as the argument to the guarded owner lookup; fold it into the only_owner function node.
The node parameter is only used as the records key inside setABI; fold it into the setABI function node.
contentType is the direct operand of the unchecked (contentType - 1) subtraction, so it merges into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
The data parameter is only stored into records by setABI; fold it into the setABI function node.
The node parameter only selects the Record storage pointer inside ABI(); fold it into the ABI function node.
The contentTypes bitmask only bounds the ABI() scan loop; fold it into the ABI function node.
The local storage pointer is a short-lived alias for records[node] used solely within ABI(); fold it into the ABI function node.
The local loop counter is the value subjected to the unchecked left shift, so it merges into that unsafe arithmetic operation.
